hotel_info.name: Royal Grand Inn
hotel_info.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before check-in. Late cancellations or no-shows will be charged for the first night.

room_types.name: Deluxe Room
room_types.description: A spacious and elegant room featuring a private balcony with breathtaking views of the ocean. Perfect for couples or solo travelers.

room_types.name: Executive Suite
room_types.description: An upscale suite offering separate living and sleeping areas, ideal for business travelers or small families looking for extra comfort.

room_types.name: Presidential Penthouse
room_types.description: The ultimate luxury experience. A massive penthouse occupies the top floor, featuring a private rooftop pool and elite personalized services.

amenities.name: Infinity Pool
amenities.details: Heated outdoor infinity pool overlooking the ocean. Towels are provided at the pool deck.

amenities.name: Grand Spa & Wellness
amenities.details: Full-service spa offering massages, facials, saunas, and steam rooms. Reservations are highly recommended.

amenities.name: Fitness Center
amenities.details: Equipped with modern cardio machines, free weights, and yoga mats. Accessible with room key.

amenities.name: Rooftop Lounge (The Horizon)
amenities.details: Cocktail bar and lounge offering fine dining and panoramic sunset views. Smart casual dress code.

dining.room_service: Available 24/7. Dial 4 from your room phone to order or order directly through Sophia AI Concierge. A 15% service charge applies.

faq.question: Is there free Wi-Fi?
faq.answer: Yes, we provide free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the entire hotel. Connect to 'Royal_Grand_Free_WiFi' - no password required.

faq.question: Do you offer parking?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer valet parking for $30 per night with unlimited in/out privileges. Self-parking is not available.

faq.question: Are pets allowed?
faq.answer: Yes, we are a pet-friendly hotel! Dogs and cats under 25 lbs are welcome. A non-refundable pet cleaning fee of $50 per stay applies. Maximum 2 pets per room.

faq.question: Do you have a shuttle service?
faq.answer: We offer a complimentary shuttle service to and from Miami International Airport (MIA) every hour on the hour between 6:00 AM and 10:00 PM. Please book at least 2 hours in advance at the reception desk.

faq.question: Can I request a late check-out?
faq.answer: Standard check-out is 11:00 AM. Late check-out up to 1:00 PM is complimentary subject to availability. Check-out until 4:00 PM is available for a fee of 50% of the room rate.
